reports.title: Mister Twister’s 7-inch RT Slug SI
reports.text:
Mister Twister rep Greg Yates lifts a 7-pound bass up high after catching it in May, two months before the soft plastic was released by Mister Twister.
This salt-infused soft plastic captivates bass with its lifelike colors and movement
An Oak Point, Texas, bass fisherman got his hands on a new soft plastic jerkbait 5 ½ months ago that impressed him with its ability to consistently get bass to open their jaws and chomp.
Greg Yates was one of the lucky ones at the time because Mister Twister’s 7-inch RT Slug SI soft plastic just hit the market in late summer, according to sales manager Darryl Laurent. The first orders went out in mid-August, Laurent said.

reports.title: Lake Lincoln State Park
reports.text:
This park and its lake abound in aquatic activities
Lake Lincoln State Park covers about 1,000 acres of Lincoln County at 2573 Sunset Road NE east of Wesson with easy access to Interstate 55 south of Jackson.
“Lake Lincoln State Park is a relatively new state park,” said Cindy Dunn, the park manager. “It became a state park in 1996. Its unique history includes preventing flooding miles away from the lake itself. It is the largest of five lakes built in the 1980s to mitigate flooding from the Pearl River basin.”
